title: myCount — time counter to a date
introTitle: How many seconds until a given date?
introText: Enter a date and time below. myCount shows the remaining time in seconds, minutes, hours, days, and more.
tzLocalHint: Time is in your local zone
linkHint: «Short link» gives …/s/XXXXXX with a Telegram preview. Old long links keep working as before.
shareInstantHint: Everyone hits zero at the same moment worldwide (classic t link).
shareLocalTemplate: Until {date} in the recipient's local time
shareLocalHint: Each person counts to that date and time in their own timezone — great for birthdays.
shareOnceHint: Unchecked = one-time date: once it passes, the counter flips to time elapsed.
textLimitHint: Up to {n} characters — the text goes into the link and the preview card.
eventsHint: Use arrows to browse — past dates show elapsed time, future dates show time remaining.
messengerLinkHint: Preview shows the event title (Telegram, etc.).
